title: Summoning the egg in daylight after leaving the program

tellings.quote: Behind that, the egg flies by um in dead silence, makes a turn and comes around in to land and disappears behind the house.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot who says he once helped recover an egg-shaped craft, told the podcast host Jesse Michels that in August 2024, after leaving that secret program, he saw the egg again in the desert, in daylight. He says it flew by in dead silence, turned, came in to land and disappeared behind a house, and he names Garry Nolan, a Stanford scientist, as a witness, and mentions AARO, the Pentagon's UFO office. If true, it would mean the object can be called up on purpose, outside any government project.
